segments.text:
The third is, the hatred and detestation of sinne, because it is sinne, and specially of a mans owne corruptions: wherewith a Christian is so turmoyled, that in regard of them and for no other cause, he most hartely desireth to bee forth of this most miserable world, that he may be dis•urdened of his sinne, & leaue off to displease God. Paul feeles in himselfe a la•ge masse of deadly corruption,
it makes him deeme himselfe most miserable, and to mourne because he was not deliuered from it, saying
Oh miserable man that I am, who shall deliuer me from this bodie of death? Againe, it is sinne that makes the Church cō
plaine that
shee is blacke, that the sunne hath looked vpon her, and therefore shee cries,
Come Lord Iesus, come quickly.
